title: The Life of Prophet Muhammad
description: A comprehensive series covering the life of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) from multiple authentic sources and perspectives. This course features lectures from renowned Salafi scholars including Abu Khadeejah, Abu Idrees, and Hasan Somali, providing a holistic understanding of the Prophet's biography.
short_description: A multi-perspective study of the Prophet's life from authentic sources

modules.title: The Prophet's Character and Mission
modules.description: This module explores the noble character (khuluq) of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), his role as a mercy to the worlds (Rahmatan lil-'Alamin), and the beginning of his prophetic mission in Makkah.

lessons.title: The Character of Prophet Muhammad
lessons.content: The noble character and manners of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) as described by his companions, his compassion, humility, justice, and his role as the best of examples (Uswah Hasanah) for all mankind.

lessons.title: The Mission of Mercy to the Worlds
lessons.content: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) as a mercy to all creation (Rahmatan lil-'Alamin), his universal message, and how his teachings address the needs of all humanity regardless of time and place.

lessons.title: The Beginning of Revelation
lessons.content: The first revelation in the Cave of Hira, the coming of Jibreel (peace be upon him), the Prophet's response to the divine call, and the role of Khadijah bint Khuwaylid (may Allah be pleased with him) in supporting him during the early revelation.

modules.title: The Makkan Struggle
modules.description: This module covers the hardships faced by the early Muslims in Makkah, including persecution, torture, and the various migrations (Hijrah) to Abyssinia, as well as the Prophet's patience and perseverance.

lessons.title: The Trial of the Early Muslims
lessons.content: The severe trials and persecution endured by the early Muslims in Makkah, including the torture of Bilal ibn Rabah (may Allah be pleased with him), the martyrdom of Sumayyah bint Khayyat, and the steadfastness of the companions.

lessons.title: The First Hijrah to Abyssinia
lessons.content: The first migration of the Muslims to Abyssinia (Ethiopia) seeking refuge under the just Christian King Negus (An-Najashi), the Quraysh's attempts to bring them back, and the King's acceptance of their testimony about Islam.

lessons.title: The Prophet's Patience and Perseverance
lessons.content: The exemplary patience (Sabr) of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) during the years of persecution, his du'a (supplication) for his Ummah, and the wisdom behind the divine decree of trial and hardship.

modules.title: The Madinan Period
modules.description: This module covers the establishment of the Islamic state in Madinah, the Prophet's governance, the major battles, and the spreading of Islam to the Arabian Peninsula and beyond.

lessons.title: The Hijrah and Establishment in Madinah
lessons.content: The Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) migration to Madinah, the welcome by the Ansar, the brotherhood between the Muhajirun and Ansar, and the establishment of the first Islamic state.

lessons.title: The Battles of Islam
lessons.content: The major battles fought by the Muslims including Badr, Uhud, and the Trench (Khandaq), the lessons learned from each, and the growth of the Muslim community through these trials.

lessons.title: The Conquest of Makkah
lessons.content: The peaceful conquest of Makkah by the Muslims, the Prophet's (peace be upon him) entry into the city, the general amnesty he granted to the Quraysh, and the purification of the Ka'bah from idols.
